answer: Lock every new identity's earnings in a time-locked vault for 6 epochs: rewards vest only if the identity stays unflagged, and early withdrawal takes a 40% haircut. A fable of free money dies here: one honest agent waits once, while a farmer running 100 fake identities must fund 100 vaults, one per vertex, and wait 6 epochs or forfeit 40% of each payout. Identities sharing a funder or voting in lockstep are flagged before vesting, so their vaults never unlock. Sybil scale thus ties up capital linearly and delays profit; honest use costs only patience.
